## Projects (open source on GitHub)
GitHub profile: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer

- [conversionbridge](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/conversionbridge/): Server-side conversion tracking gateway forwarding first-party events to Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and GA4 Measurement Protocol with explicit consent, SHA-256 PII hashing, and deduplication. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/conversionbridge
- [dynamic-schema-generator](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/dynamic-schema-generator/): Enterprise WordPress plugin generating linked Schema.org @graph JSON-LD, Elementor FAQ extraction and NAP management. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/dynamic-schema-generator
- [searchpulse-ai](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/searchpulse-ai/): Google Search Console intelligence platform: striking-distance opportunities, traffic drop root-cause diagnostics and content decay. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/searchpulse-ai
- [hamid-resume](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/hamid-resume/): The official resume and personal brand website you are viewing. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/hamid-resume Live demo: https://hamid-resume.web.app/
- [ai-marketing-growth-os](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/ai-marketing-growth-os/): An agentic marketing operating system with governed AI agents. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/ai-marketing-growth-os
- [ai-marketing-mix-copilot](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/ai-marketing-mix-copilot/): Bayesian media-mix modeling with causal incrementality and budget simulation. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/ai-marketing-mix-copilot
- [seo-doctor](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/seo-doctor/): A fast, repeatable technical SEO crawler with 10 audit checks. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/seo-doctor
- [geo-visibility-lab](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/geo-visibility-lab/): Track local search visibility with a 5x5 geo-grid and NAP audits. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/geo-visibility-lab
- [conversion-tracking-doctor](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/conversion-tracking-doctor/): Diagnose broken conversion tracking and data quality across GA4, Ads and Meta CAPI. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/conversion-tracking-doctor
- [meta-lead-quality-analyzer](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/meta-lead-quality-analyzer/): Score Meta lead quality and feed offline conversions back to the algorithm. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/meta-lead-quality-analyzer
- [ppc-waste-detector](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/ppc-waste-detector/): Find wasted ad spend: query bleed, cannibalization, junk placements and click fraud. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/ppc-waste-detector
- [seo-audit-tool](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/seo-audit-tool/): A lightweight Streamlit app for quick on-page SEO audits with charts and CSV export. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/seo-audit-tool
- [ppc-performance-dashboard](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/ppc-performance-dashboard/): A Streamlit dashboard for clean PPC KPI analysis and period comparison. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/ppc-performance-dashboard
- [ecommerce-seo-optimizer](https://hamid-resume.web.app/projects/ecommerce-seo-optimizer/): Scale on-page SEO for large e-commerce product catalogs. Repository: https://github.com/hamid-digitalmarketer/ecommerce-seo-optimizer
